title: Blue Hour and Aftermath
author: Wren Okonkwo
blurb: Yara Blackwood, a former prodigy returning to the conservatory as a janitor, keeps a careful inventory of everything unsaid. But when a box of undelivered letters surfaces behind a wardrobe, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must say goodbye properly, at last, out loud before the demolition date arrives.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
